about_the_game:
Survive. Adapt. Overcome

Dive into the relentless chaos of Zombitality, a fast-paced action-packed shooter blending auto-combat mechanics with strategic skill usage. Command a squad of elite survivors, each with unique abilities and weapons, as you carve your way through hordes of undead in pulse-pounding corridor-style levels.

Gameplay Highlights

Dynamic Squad Management: Control a team of 3 specialized fighters - assault troopers, snipers, medics, and more - each equipped with distinct weapons and skills tailored to their class.

Real-Time Action with Strategic Depth: While basic attacks are automatic, you’ll strategically deploy powerful abilities with cooldowns to turn the tide of battle. Use active pause mode for precise targeting when things get overwhelming.

Level-Up on the Fly: Earn buffs during combat by defeating enemies, giving your squad temporary boosts to survive increasingly challenging encounters.

Post-Battle Progression: After every fight, upgrade your characters' skills, unlock new abilities, or equip better weapons to stay ahead of the ever-growing threat.

Key Features

Zombie Mayhem

Navigate long, claustrophobic locations filled with waves of zombies triggered by environmental cues. Your goal? Reach the evacuation point alive—but it won’t be easy. Face off against massive hordes and towering bosses that will test your tactical prowess.

Unlock new skills and optimize builds to suit your playstyle.

Power-Ups and Buffs

Scattered throughout the maps are game-changing bonuses that can make survival just a little bit easier. From increased damage output to faster cooldowns, these rewards ensure no two runs feel the same.

Progression System

Between missions, invest in permanent upgrades for your squad members. Choose from an array of enhancements, including new weapons, improved stats, and devastating special moves.

Why Play Zombie Rush?

Fast-Paced Fun: The combination of auto-combat and manual skill selection keeps the gameplay engaging without being overwhelming.

Challenging Yet Rewarding: Every level offers escalating challenges, ensuring constant tension and satisfaction when you emerge victorious.

High Replayability: With multiple character classes, skill trees, and randomized power-ups, no two playthroughs are alike.

Are You Ready?

The undead apocalypse awaits. Gather your squad, sharpen your skills, and prepare to fight your way to safety in Zombitality. Can you survive long enough to see the dawn?
